title: A Primitive Theory of General Intelligence: A Global Mathematical Verification Closed-Loop Framework for Next-Generation Models (Research Proposal)
summary: Existing Transformer and large language model frameworks adopt a "prediction-first" paradigm, defining intelligence as fitting real-world data distributions and next-token prediction. This work presents a novel primitive account of intelligence: intelligence arises from continuous, multi-layered global closed-loop mathematical verification and constraint checking. All AI behaviors including fitting, reasoning, association, generation, generalization, error correction and cognition can be reinterpreted as mathematical comparison, constraint validation, differential stability checking and…
